prompt.description: The final, fully-composed image-generation prompt — ready to send straight to the image render provider. Keep it at or below the caller-supplied prompt_max_chars budget; Kie.ai image models may use up to 20,000 characters, while the legacy fallback is 3,800. A downstream QC pass may still refine/compress it, but a well-written prompt should not rely on that fallback.

negative_prompt.description: The final negative prompt. Preserves the shot's existing negative-prompt content and adds any new negative terms this action's instructions require (e.g. anti-burned-in-text terms for multi_angle_grid).
